name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I know how cheap Lotwil can be, adventurer, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention.

I've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course.

I'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.
narrative.objectives: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Here you go, adventurer. Try these on.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I wouldn't wait too long to get that bracer, adventurer.

Who knows what's going to happen next?
